interface.name: trierarch_adreno_presenter_v1
interface.description:
This private protocol is intentionally not a replacement for linux-dmabuf. It is an opt-in path for a Mesa Wayland EGL presenter that renders into buffers allocated by the Android host.
A client must inspect capabilities before creating a buffer. An absent capability means it must continue with its normal Wayland EGL path.

request.name: create_buffer
request.description: The reply is sent on the newly-created buffer object. The client must not attach or submit it before receiving ready.

interface.name: trierarch_adreno_buffer_v1
interface.description: The host creates the wl_buffer only after it has allocated an Android AHardwareBuffer and exported an importable guest handle. wl_buffer release remains the normal Wayland reuse signal.

entry.name: no_memory
entry.summary: host could not allocate a buffer

request.name: submit
request.description: The client sends the native fence fd after it has rendered the buffer and before the associated wl_surface commit. The host waits for this fence before sampling the Android buffer.

description.summary: host buffer is ready for guest rendering
host could not provide the requested buffer
